content: {"episode_id":"ep-05161","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) for this episode. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia, consistent with diagnosis codes I47.1 and R42. Given the history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, coded as G45.9, the note states that prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with these neurological symptoms and dizziness. We therefore request reconsideration of the determination that this service is not covered, based on the documented clinical necessity above."}
